text:
sam: quick idea to simplify midstream retry complexity: introduce a tiny "fallback-proxy" behavior at the edge that on upstream aborts either returns a cached snapshot or issues a single non-stream retry, always signalling clients with a short SSE event. keeps no lease handoffs.

nina: makes sense. tradeoff = lose incremental UI. should be opt-in per-route.

youssef: two ops concerns: 1) duplicate side-effects if backend already ran tools; 2) billing attribution.

sam: require Idempotency-Key for reruns; if missing fallback returns a 409-like degraded payload. bill only the final successful run and tag telemetry as fallback=true.

tara: config sketch: {"fallback_mode":"single_retry|cache","allow_for_tiers":["free","dev"],"sse_event":"edge.degraded"}. also expose header X-Edge-Fallback:cache|rerun|none.

youssef: impl sketch:
```
on_midstream_error(req):
  emit_sse(client, {degraded:true, reason:"upstream_error"})
  close_upstream()
  if cache.hit and route.allow_cache: send_single_chunk(cache.get)
  elif req.headers.Idempotency-Key: resp=call_backend_nonstream(req); send_single_chunk(resp)
  else: send_error_chunk("cannot rerun without idempotency")
```

nina: metrics: edge.fallback.count, edge.fallback.cache_hit, edge.fallback.rerun_count, edge.fallback.no_idempotency. add trace span fallback_trace_id linking to attempted lease ops for debuggability.

sam: SDK note: detect SSE edge.degraded and show a small banner. docs snippet later.

bot-deploy: checklist: add feature-flag ingress.fallback.single_retry, update proxy schema, add integration test that simulates midstream abort and validates SSE + single chunk.

youssef: load concern: reruns could spike backend qps. recommend rate-limit fallback attempts per-route and circuit-break metric to auto-disable.

sam: agreed. rollout: behind flag -> internal canary -> enable for non-critical tiers -> monitor for 72h. I'll draft a 1-pager and a small diagram contrasting resume vs fallback.

nina: +1. I'll add tests and metrics dashboard panels.

sam: thanks all.
